    Authorization context cache¶

    rn_forge.auth.context_cache ¶

    In-process cache of authorization contexts.

    AccountStateWriter ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Persists the account state that an authorization context carries.

    bump_session_version(account_id) ¶

    Increase the session version of account_id and return the new one.

    set_active(account_id, active) ¶

    Store whether account_id may authenticate.

    AuthorizationContextCache(provider, *, ttl=timedelta(seconds=60), versions=None, writer=None, clock=time.monotonic) ¶

    An :class:AuthorizationContextProvider that caches another one.

    Each account has one entry, valid while the account and global versions are those it was computed at and it is younger than ttl. Changes made through :meth:invalidate, :meth:invalidate_all, :meth:set_active and :meth:bump_session_version apply on the next :meth:resolve. A change made any other way applies once the entry's ttl has passed. The cache is safe to share between threads and is local to the process.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    provider AuthorizationContextProvider

    The provider that computes contexts.

    		 required
    ttl timedelta

    The longest an entry is served. Must be positive.

    		 timedelta(seconds=60)
    versions AuthorizationVersions | None

    The version counters. Defaults to a new :class:InMemoryAuthorizationVersions.

    		 None
    writer AccountStateWriter | None

    Persists account state for :meth:set_active and :meth:bump_session_version.

    		 None
    clock Callable[[], float]

    Returns the current time in seconds, monotonic.

    		 monotonic

    Raises:

    Type Description
    ValueError

    ttl is not positive.

    AuthorizationVersions ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Counters that say when cached authorization contexts are stale.

    bump(account_id) ¶

    Increase the version of account_id.

    bump_all() ¶

    Increase the global version, which every account shares.

    current(account_id) ¶

    Return the account's version and the global version.

    InMemoryAuthorizationVersions() ¶

    :class:AuthorizationVersions held in process memory.

    Thread-safe. The counters are not shared across processes, so a bump is seen only by caches that use the same instance.

    bump(account_id) ¶

    Increase the version of account_id.

    bump_all() ¶

    Increase the global version.

    Return the account's version and the global version.
